title: Evidence-source colours differ on every view (three conflicting hard-coded maps)
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-data/ds-desktop-light.png (ClinGen amber, GenCC green, HPO violet, DiagnosticPanels red) vs EvidenceCompositionChart weights donut (ClinGen #C9CBCF grey, GenCC #FF9F40 orange, HPO #36A2EB blue, DiagnosticPanels #FFCE56 yellow) vs gene-detail EvidenceCard (ClinGen #22c55e green, GenCC #8b5cf6 violet, HPO #3b82f6 blue). UpSet uses no source colour at all (black/grey bars).
impact: Users learn "ClinGen = amber" on one page and "ClinGen = green/grey" on the next; colour cannot identify a source, contradicting Product Principle 2.
fix: Create one SOURCE_CONFIG (label, colour token, icon, description) next to TIER_CONFIG in src/utils, define --source-* tokens in main.css for light/dark, validate CVD distance like tierPalette.spec.ts, and import it in DataSources, EvidenceCompositionChart, EvidenceCard, UpSet set bars and Home.

title: ClinGen/GenCC classification colours on the Distributions donut are index-based and contradict gene-detail colours
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-data/dash-distributions-mobile-dark.png: Definitive=blue, Strong=orange, Moderate=green, Limited=red, Disputed=purple. On /genes/:symbol ClinGen/GenCC cards Definitive/Strong=green, Moderate=blue, Limited=amber, Disputed=red. Colours are assigned by array index, so they change if API order changes.
impact: An ordinal scale (Definitive > … > Disputed) is shown as unordered categorical hues; "Definitive" is green in one place and blue in another; green/red adjacency (Moderate/Limited) fails deuteranopia.
fix: Add a CLASSIFICATION_CONFIG (ordinal, colourblind-validated) keyed by classification and use it in SourceDistributionsChart, ClinGenEvidence, GenCCEvidence and the curated-association strength chip.

title: Backend still ships a fourth, different tier colour map
evidence: GET /api/statistics/evidence-composition returns comprehensive_support "#4CAF50", multi_source "#2196F3", established "#1976D2", preliminary "#FFC107" vs TIER_CONFIG #16a34a/#2563eb/#38bdf8/#fbbf24. Frontend overrides it (EvidenceCompositionChart.vue:153), so the tier donut is correct today and matches the dashboard chips.
impact: API/MCP consumers and any future component that reads tier.color get colours that disagree with the UI.
fix: Drop colour from the API payload (presentation concern) or derive it from one tier definition; keep TIER_CONFIG as the single UI source.

title: hsl(var(--token)) wraps OKLCH tokens, so the declarations are invalid and silently dropped
evidence: main.css defines --card/--border/--muted/--chart-* as oklch(); hsl(oklch(...)) is invalid. UpSet source-selection panel background, chart-container border, network dark canvas fill and Enrichment FDR row tint all fall back to transparent/none (/tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-data/dash-overlaps-desktop-light.png, net-hpo-desktop-dark.png).
impact: Intended surfaces, borders and FDR significance highlighting never render; dark-mode parity depends on accident.
fix: Replace hsl(var(--x)) with var(--x) and hsl(var(--x) / a) with color-mix(in oklab, var(--x) a%, transparent); add a lint check banning "hsl(var(".

title: Tabs, Switch, Select triggers and default Buttons show the default cursor
evidence: Computed cursor=default on TabsTrigger "Overlaps/Distributions/Composition", Switch "Include zero-score genes", Select "ClinGen", Composition toggle "Tiers/Coverage/Weights", network "3 tier(s) selected", "Leiden", "Clusters...", Network/Enrichment tabs, "Size/Spatial" sort, header Login/theme (results.json probe, all viewports/themes).
impact: Tailwind v4 dropped the pointer default for buttons; controls feel inert.
fix: Add to @layer base: button:not(:disabled), [role=button], [role=tab], [role=switch], [role=combobox], [role=option], summary, label[for] { cursor: pointer }.

title: Bar and donut marks show cursor:pointer but are not clickable
evidence: D3BarChart/D3DonutChart set cursor pointer on every bar/arc but bind only mouseover/mouseout; clicking does nothing (/tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-data/dash-distributions-hover.png).
impact: False affordance: users click expecting to drill into genes and nothing happens.
fix: Remove the pointer, or make the mark a real action (link to /genes filtered by that classification/coverage) with keyboard focus.

title: Chart tooltips are mouse-only; marks are not focusable; bar charts have no text values
evidence: D3 bars/arcs and UpSet bars have no tabindex/role/aria-label; values only in hover tooltips. Donut has a text legend (good), bar chart has none.
impact: Keyboard, screen-reader and touch users cannot read bar values.
fix: Add role="img" + aria-label summary per chart and the donut legend pattern (or value labels) for bar charts.

title: Chart loading uses a 64px spinner (three copies) instead of a layout-matched skeleton
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-data/loading-dash.png: generic "Loading component..." box, then a 400px spinner per chart; spinner markup copy-pasted in three charts.
impact: Inconsistent with DataSources skeletons; spinner-to-content swap feels slower.
fix: Extract a ChartSkeleton (header row + stat row + chart box at final height) and use it in all three charts.

title: Overlaps tab renders an empty card with no message when the source list fails to load
evidence: First capture run (API unreachable from the browser): Overlaps card was blank while Distributions/Composition showed "Network Error". loadAvailableSources only logs; selectedSources stays [], loadData returns early with no error; the "No Sources Selected" empty state sits inside v-else-if="data" so it never shows.
impact: Users see an empty chart and cannot tell no-data from failure; no retry.
fix: Set error.value in the loadAvailableSources catch and render ComponentError with retry; move the empty state out of the data branch.

title: Chart errors show the raw Axios text "Network Error" with no retry
evidence: First capture run: Distributions and Composition cards showed only a red "Network Error" alert.
impact: Does not say what failed or what to do; inconsistent with ComponentError used on /data-sources.
fix: Use the shared ComponentError (message + retry) in every chart.

title: UpSet plot uses its own font, black bars and a tiny SHARE/DUMP/VEGA/PNG/SVG toolbar
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-data/dash-overlaps-desktop-light.png: set labels in a different face/size, plot offset inside the card, bottom-right micro buttons (~8px text) "DUMP", "VEGA".
impact: Looks bolted on, breaks the type scale; developer jargon and <24px targets.
fix: Pass fontFamily/fontSizes and token colours to renderUpSet, hide exportButtons (or map to one app Export button), centre the plot.

title: Source names shown as code keys ("DiagnosticPanels") on charts, chips and cards
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-data/dash-overlaps-desktop-light.png chips and UpSet rows; ds-desktop-light.png card title; mobile overlap table "DiagnosticPanels ∩ HPO ∩ Literature".
impact: Reads as an internal identifier, not vocabulary geneticists use.
fix: Map source keys to display labels ("Diagnostic panels") in the shared SOURCE_CONFIG.

title: "Single Source Only: 6" counts combinations, not genes; ClinGen total 192 vs 184 elsewhere; "2045" unformatted
evidence: UpSet stat "6 Single Source Only" equals the number of sources (single_source_combinations). Distributions shows ClinGen "192 Total Genes" while UpSet set size and /data-sources show 184 ClinGen genes (192 = sum of classification rows). Donut centre "2045" vs "2,045" elsewhere (/tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-data/dash-composition-desktop-light.png).
impact: Contradictory denominators undermine trust on a provenance-focused site.
fix: Show genes in exactly one source (or relabel "single-source combinations"); label 192 as gene–classification records or dedupe; toLocaleString in donut centre.

title: Tier filter chips lack the tier-definition tooltip; off state is 30% opacity
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-data/dash-overlaps-desktop-light.png: TIER_CONFIG.description exists but no tooltip; unselected chips drop to opacity-30 (contrast fail) once a tier is chosen.
impact: Users cannot learn what a tier means here; dimmed chips fall below 3:1.
fix: Use a shared TierChip with tooltip and a check/outline off state instead of opacity.

title: Card inside card inside card (Dashboard Card > chart Card > metadata Card)
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-data/dash-distributions-desktop-light.png triple borders; on mobile the nesting eats ~70px so titles wrap to 3 lines (/tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-data/dash-overlaps-mobile-light.png).
impact: Visual noise and wasted width.
fix: Charts render content only (no outer Card), or drop the Dashboard wrapper card.

title: Tab labels truncate to "Overla…", "Distrib…", "Comp…" at 390px; 12px remove-source buttons
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-data/dash-overlaps-mobile-light.png; probe: "Remove ClinGen" etc. 12×12px; Switch 32×18px.
impact: Labels unreadable; 12px targets fail WCAG 2.5.8.
fix: Shorter labels or scrollable TabsList on mobile; enlarge remove buttons to a 24px hit area.

title: Tiers/Coverage/Weights toggle has no pressed state; donut centre label 11px at 60% opacity
evidence: Buttons only switch variant (no aria-pressed/radiogroup). Centre label font-size 11px, opacity 0.6.
impact: Screen readers cannot tell the active view; small low-contrast text fails 1.4.3.
fix: Use a ToggleGroup (type=single); centre label ≥12px muted-foreground without opacity.

title: Bar charts hard-code #2196F3/#1E88E5 instead of a token
evidence: bar-color="#2196F3" and "#1E88E5"; D3BarChart fallback #1976D2.
impact: Off-token blues; per-source bars could carry the source colour.
fix: Default to var(--chart-1) or the source token.

title: White source names on light gradients fail contrast (2.2–2.8:1)
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-data/ds-desktop-light.png: white 18px bold on #0EA5E9 (2.77:1), #F59E0B (2.15:1), #10B981 (2.54:1); text-xs subtitle the same. 18px bold is not large text, so 4.5:1 applies.
impact: Source names on PanelApp, ClinGen, GenCC, Literature cards are hard to read; WCAG 1.4.3 failure in both themes.
fix: Drop the saturated band: neutral header with a source-colour accent (left border or icon chip) from the shared source tokens.

title: Literature card reuses the PanelApp colour and a generic icon
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-data/ds-mobile-light.png: Literature header is the same blue as PanelApp; getSourceGradient/getSourceIcon have no Literature entry.
impact: Two sources look identical.
fix: Drive gradient/icon from SOURCE_CONFIG covering all 7 sources.

title: Gradient header floats 24px below the card edge with a large gap before the body
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-data/ds-desktop-light.png: white strip above each band and ~40px gap below it, from Card base "py-6 gap-6".

title: Stat numbers use raw green/blue/purple classes that carry no meaning

title: Contradictory or ungrammatical counts: "814 Genes / 0 Records", "1 Providers", 6 active vs 7 cards, coverage without denominator

title: HPO statistics chips use white text on amber/green/grey/orange (1.6–2.8:1)
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-data/net-cluster-dialog-desktop-light.png: "Pediatric" white on #FFC107 (1.63:1), "Adult" on #4CAF50 (2.78:1), "Not Classified" on #9E9E9E (2.68:1), "Tubulopathy" on #FF9800 (2.16:1); cluster badge white on palette (#bcbd22 2.0:1).

title: Cluster and HPO palettes are Material/d3 hexes, separate from app tokens and from the backend cluster palette
evidence: CLUSTER_PALETTE (d3 category10), HPO clinical/onset/syndromic Material hexes; backend generate_cluster_colors has its own palette; NetworkGraph hard-codes #1976D2 nodes, #FFC107 highlight, #cccccc edges, #fafafa canvas, #000 labels with #fff outline, tooltip #212121/#bbdefb.
impact: CAKUT blue equals the Multi-Source tier blue; Glomerulopathy red vs Adult/Moderate green fail deuteranopia; canvas styling is light-only.

title: Network nodes are clickable but the canvas cursor stays "auto"
evidence: results.json net-canvas-cursor-desktop-light = auto; node click opens the gene dialog.

title: Gene dialogs show an internal numeric "Gene ID" (e.g. 6735) instead of an HGNC ID and name
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-data/net-cluster-dialog-desktop-light.png: Gene ID column 6735, 7360…, no prefix, no link, no gene name.

title: 27 clusters named only "Cluster 1…27"; clusters 11+ share grey without a label
